judge: python3 docs/lanes/audio1016/tools/mixlog_read.py <logcat>; python3 docs/lanes/audio1016/tools/level_windows.py <logcat> (the hakuX-audio level meter's 5 s windows)
baseline: Offline, from the owner's MKSM save state (NOTES.md): the cutscene voice v164 sits in five speaker bins (xFL, xBL, xFR, xBR, C) at -11.2 dB each; the title's own GP/EP program plays it 3.6-5.2 dB above a front-left/right voice at the same volume, MON_VP plays it level with one. Owner logcat 10-14: MKSM intro FMV -17.7 to -22.4 dBFS, the in-engine cutscene -28 to -31.
prediction: V: every run logs 'monvp_downmix: on' (R2, R5) or 'off' (R1, R3, R4) once, and >= 20 windows of apumix lines. M (MKSM layout, R1): the loudest long voice of the intro FMV is a stereo voice in FL/FR only (mixlog_read.py excess 0.0 / 0.0), P 0.6; if it is multi-bin with excess >= 3 dB, (a) does not explain the FMV-to-cutscene gap by balance and the note says so. S (switch leaves single-bin voices alone, R1 vs R2): in windows whose top voice has excess 0, the level meter's acrms differs by <= 1.5 dB between R1 and R2 at matching content, P 0.8. U (switch raises multi-bin voices, R1 vs R2): any window whose top voice has excess >= 3 dB is louder in R2 by excess +/- 3 dB, P 0.6 (no such window from boot without a route is possible; then U is 'not reached', not a failure). H (Halo, R3): report every voice with excess >= 3 dB; P 0.5 that the menu music is single-bin. C (clipping, R4 vs R5): the level meter's clipped-sample count in R5 is within 2x of R4 plus 100 samples per window, P 0.5; a larger rise means the switch needs a trim before it can be default-on, and the note says by how much.

legs.V: grep 'monvp_downmix:' and count apumix windows per run

legs.U: as S, windows whose top voice has excess >= 3 dB
legs.C: level meter clipped counts, R4 vs R5
